# DSE — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

HKDSE revision notes for physics, chemistry, biology, maths, economics, and ICT with worked examples aligned to the HKEAA curriculum.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Overview

- [About This Site](https://dse.wyattau.com/about/): About Wyatt's Notes DSE preparation resources, experience, expertise, and credentials behind the Hong Kong DSE exam materials.
- [Complete DSE Study Guide, Everything You Need to Pass](https://dse.wyattau.com/hub/): Study notes for Complete DSE Study Guide, Everything You Need to Pass with worked examples, practice problems, and key concepts for exam preparation.
- [DSE Exam Glossary, Key Terms Across All Subjects](https://dse.wyattau.com/glossary/): Compulsory Module: A module that all candidates must take as part of a subject. Forms the foundation of the subject curriculum.
- [DSE Notes](https://dse.wyattau.com/): HKDSE revision notes for physics, chemistry, biology, maths, economics, and ICT with worked examples aligned to the HKEAA curriculum.
- [DSE Practice Test, 50 Questions Across All Subjects](https://dse.wyattau.com/practice-test-mega/): 50 exam-style DSE practice questions covering Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Maths, and Economics. Multiple choice with detailed explanations, difficulty ratings, and a hidden answer key.
